Platform roles (desktop launcher / browser / dialer / SMS) are requested via the system role dialog; this app has no desktop UI, so "Desktop launcher" only submits a role request, and whether it takes effect depends on whether the system lists it as an eligible candidate.
Album / video / mail / doc have no system role; tapping "Set as default" opens the system chooser — pick Zorv AI and check "Always".
To clear default, go to System Settings → Apps → Zorv AI → Open by default / Default apps, or the default app management page for that type.

Permission definitions (ai.aci.permission.* etc.) are maintained by the control-end project; this app only declares and uses them, no duplication.
